Early work set the scene (Adams, 2010). Later, Baker (2015a) extended it, and others followed (Clark et al., 2019, p. 12). Dunn (n.d.) offers a contrasting view (see also Evans, 2012).

References

Adams, R. (2010). First steps. Journal A, 1, 1-5.
Baker, T. (2015b). Next steps. Journal B, 2, 6-9.
Clark, P., Day, S., & Ford, H. (2019). Group work. Journal C, 3, 10-20.
Dunn, L. (n.d.). Undated report. Retrieved from a library.
Grant, W. (2001). Never cited. Old Press.
